---
title: "Which manual is yours?"
toc: false
---

The shop's standard procedures, written for the three kinds of people who use
the system. Start with your own manual; each one is complete on its own.

::: {.manual-cards}

::: {.manual-card}
### [Groomer manual](groomer/index.qmd)

For everyone on the floor. Signing in, finding a dog, checking it in, and
recording the haircut.
:::

::: {.manual-card}
### [Manager manual](manager/index.qmd)

Everything in the groomer manual, plus Admin: verifying paperwork, second
looks, and the to-do list.
:::

::: {.manual-card}
### [Systems manual](systems/index.qmd)

For whoever looks after the database and the AI that reads paperwork. The
shop's rules, backups, and keeping the AI honest.
:::

:::
